title: Project 82 / BuAer Project 171 Jan-Feb 1952 Personnel Balloon Radar-Test Manifest
purpose: Preserve a finite, source-described human-made high-altitude balloon test campaign as a calibration event manifest before any comparison with Blue Book STARLIKE or POSS-I outcomes.

authority.agency_archive: CIA FOIA / declassified Office of Naval Research field-test report embedded in APD Project 82 completion record
authority.document_title: COMPLETION OF APD PROJECT #82, RADAR DETECTION TESTS, PERSONNEL BALLOON.
authority.source_transport_note: The CIA automated endpoint has exhibited redirect loops in the JPFM-4A byte-freeze environment. This manifest binds to the publicly indexed authority transcription and does not claim a local raw-PDF SHA-256.
authority.source_level_statement: The report states that thirteen balloons were expended between 1952-01-10 and 1952-02-18: eleven successful manned flights, one cell destroyed on the ground because of unfavorable winds, and one failed/cancelled cell. Each numbered flight is described in sequence.

admission_semantics.non_event_days_inside_campaign: NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_GLOBAL_NO_BALLOON_DAYS; only no Project-82 numbered event in this finite campaign
admission_semantics.poss_physical_contamination_attribution: NOT_ESTABLISHED; launch geography and line-of-sight/trajectory must be compatible with Palomar before any direct contamination claim
admission_semantics.abort_dates_role: NEGATIVE_PHYSICAL_AIRBORNE_CONTROL_WITH_ACTIVE_LAUNCH_ATTEMPT; useful for separating operational/reporting context from actual airborne balloon exposure

next_gate: Freeze a Project-82-specific Blue Book spatial/temporal test: compare actual launch dates versus the two abort dates and matched nearby calendar days, require witness geography compatible with New Mexico/Texas phase, and keep POSS-I as a separate spatial-plausibility arm.
